exposure: prolapse in the anterior or posterior compartment
outcome: Choice of first-line treatment for pelvic organ prolapse (POP) (watchful waiting, pessary use, or surgery)
cohort: 794 patients referred with POP at a Danish tertiary center for urogynecology at Aalborg University Hospital between January 1, 2014 and December 31, 2015
finding: 50% of patients referred with POP were treated with surgery, while 33% chose watchful waiting and 17% chose pessary use as first-line treatment.
